title: llms-full.txt freshness could not be determined
untested_rationale: checkPresence() (validate-llms-txt.mjs) emits this composed id when neither an embedded '**Generated:**' marker nor a Last-Modified header is present on a live HTTP response -- it requires a real HTTP round-trip, not a pure-function input. Covered instead by the production smoke suite and by this repo's own composer, which embeds the Generated marker in every build (so this warn firing at all is itself a signal to investigate).

spec.name: llms.txt (llmstxt.org)
spec.normative_quote: llms-full.txt has no formal spec of its own; this id covers this repo's own freshness-determination fallback logic.
spec.note: No spec clause applies -- conformance_testable is false by construction, matching rule_class: operational.

applicability: N/A -- fires when no freshness signal is present in a live HTTP response.
